<Why>
A service slows down at night and nobody can say why, because nothing recorded how it behaved. This sample card stands in for a real lesson and shows each part a card can have.
</Why>

<Idea>
Record numbers about the service over time, then ask questions of them. This card exists to test the site, not to teach.
</Idea>

<Points>
  <Point label="Points tell the story">Each point has a label that says what it says.</Point>
  <Point label="Queries can be copied">
    <Query lang="promql">{`sum by (job) (rate(http_requests_total{job="shop"}[5m]))`}</Query>
  </Point>
  <Point label="Lab links follow the setting">Open <LabLink to="grafana" path="/explore">Explore in Grafana</LabLink> in the lab.</Point>
</Points>

<Figure id="m90-s01-flow" alt="Requests flow from a shop into a metrics store and a dashboard." brief="Test scene: a dot moves along a line while the figure is on screen." />

<Figure id="m90-s01-later" alt="A dashboard panel shows a latency line rising at night." brief="A fake Grafana panel draws a latency line that rises at night; the learner notices the rise." />

<Trap>
A sample is not a lesson. Real cards come from the content cards.
</Trap>

<Question id="q-m90-s01" answer="b">
Which of these is a number recorded over time?

- A log line

  A log line is text about one event, not a number over time.

- A metric

  Right: a metric is a number sampled over time.

- A trace

  A trace follows one request through services.

- A profile

  A profile shows where a program spends its resources.
</Question>
